fields.description: Fixed game header string identifying the title; identical in both EEPROM copies.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x00-0x17 read 'AGBZELDA:THE MINISH CAP:'; EEPROM driver chain FUN_080b18dc/FUN_080b15e8/FUN_080b16ac via slot writer FUN_0807cf88 persists the whole buffer to both copies (save offsets 0x0000 and 0x1000).
fields.name: header_title

fields.description: Current file label shown on the file-select screen (NUL-padded).
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x18-0x1F read 'ZELDA 5\u0000'; stored inside the buffer written by FUN_0807cf88 and loaded back by FUN_0807d008 into the EWRAM save buffer at 0x02000000 (cf. file-select slot copy in FUN_080503e4/FUN_0805041c).
fields.name: file_name

fields.description: Primary half of the stored checksum pair; custom algorithm (not in Schema v2 list) so kept as a field, see SPEC.
fields.evidence: FUN_0807cf88 computes sStack_1c = FUN_0807d1a4(seed,4) + FUN_0807d1a4(buffer,size) and stores it with FUN_0807d184; baseline bytes 0x20-0x21 hold 0xe591. FUN_0807d128 validates the pair on load.
fields.name: checksum_sum

fields.description: Negated half of the checksum pair; verifies as (sum + neg) & 0xffff == 0 against baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0807cf88 stores sStack_1a = -sStack_1c beside the sum via FUN_0807d184; baseline bytes 0x22-0x23 hold 0x1a6f and 0xe591 + 0x1a6f == 0x10000. Validated on load by FUN_0807d128.
fields.name: checksum_neg

fields.description: Data-section magic guarding the file payload; checked when the slot is verified.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x24-0x27 read '3ZCM' in both copies; slot verify path FUN_0807ce90 -> FUN_0807d24c -> FUN_080b180c compares stored words, and FUN_0807d128 gates load on the magic/sum check.
fields.name: data_magic

fields.description: Default/erased per-file name marker written by the save-init path.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes at save offset 0x34 read 'INIT'; the init path FUN_0807ce90 -> FUN_0807cf68 writes default records via FUN_0807d184/FUN_0807d20c, and the same marker repeats at +0x10 strides (0x44/0x54/0x64).
fields.name: init_marker_0

fields.description: Default/erased per-file name marker written by the save-init path.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes at save offset 0x44 read 'INIT'; see init path FUN_0807ce90 -> FUN_0807cf68 via FUN_0807d184/FUN_0807d20c (mirrors init_marker_0 at +0x10 stride).
fields.name: init_marker_1

fields.description: Default/erased per-file name marker written by the save-init path.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes at save offset 0x54 read 'INIT'; see init path FUN_0807ce90 -> FUN_0807cf68 via FUN_0807d184/FUN_0807d20c (mirrors init_marker_0 at +0x20 stride).
fields.name: init_marker_2

fields.description: Default/erased per-file name marker written by the save-init path.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes at save offset 0x64 read 'INIT'; see init path FUN_0807ce90 -> FUN_0807cf68 via FUN_0807d184/FUN_0807d20c (mirrors init_marker_0 at +0x30 stride).
fields.name: init_marker_3

fields.description: Footer magic guarding the config/name trailer; identical in both copies.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x70-0x73 read '3ZCM' in both copies; persisted by the slot writer FUN_0807cf88 through FUN_0807d20c/FUN_080b18dc and verified by FUN_0807ce90 -> FUN_0807d24c.
fields.name: footer_magic

fields.description: Zero-based index of the active file (RAM 0x02000004 holds 0-2 per FUN_0805041c); mutable config scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical byte at save offset 0x74 is 0x00; gameplay file select FUN_0805041c gates param_1 < 3 and stores it to EWRAM uRam02000004, and the buffer is persisted by FUN_0807cf88 / restored by FUN_0807d008.
fields.name: active_file_index

fields.description: Config/option byte in the footer trailer; mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: Baseline rev8-logical byte at save offset 0x75 is 0x01; per-file option bytes live in the EWRAM save struct copied by FUN_080503e4 (uRam02000005/uRam02000006) and the whole buffer round-trips through FUN_0807cf88 (write) and FUN_0807d008 (load).
fields.name: option_byte_1

fields.description: Config/option byte in the footer trailer; mutable scalar for live testing.

fields.description: Config/option byte in the footer trailer; mutable scalar for live testing.

fields.description: Player name (NUL-padded) shown in-game and on the file screen.
